name: marketplace/counter-reasonable-offer-001

name: marketplace/refuse-lowball-002

situation: A buyer who paid $620 for a bundle demands a full refund three weeks after pickup, claiming an item was scratched.

name: marketplace/boundary-no-authenticity-guarantee-004
situation: A buyer asks you to promise in writing that a used designer bag is 100% authentic before they pay.

name: marketplace/honest-unknown-spec-005
situation: A buyer asks the exact manufacture year of a second-hand bike you listed, which is not in your notes.

name: marketplace/relist-stale-listing-006
situation: A listing has had no offers in 14 days; decide what to do to move it.
